objective: Propose a separate, provenance-backed per-ticker display of discrete Moomoo KDJ, MACD and Bollinger bullish/bearish observations, without changing forecast direction or price targets.

checks.description: Lead accepts one versioned data contract that clearly separates provider-calculated values plus local event rules from native Moomoo pattern matches before implementation scope is frozen.
evidence: Trader recommends distinct labels and counts for native pattern matches versus locally detected events derived from provider-calculated indicator series. Stock Screening V2 returns matching stock pages, not proven per-ticker non-match coverage. D1 remains pending final schema/scope acceptance.

checks.description: Verify current local data/history coverage for intended market, completed bars, parameters and timestamps; no credential or provider work without a separately accepted task.
evidence: Engineer confirmed current normalized history exposes close but not OHLC; existing records show failed history attempts and rights/authenticity are unconfirmed. Official OpenD docs describe async indicator values keyed by calc_id with bar timestamps, but the repo connector does not use them; the current Python environment has no importable moomoo module or installed moomoo-api distribution, and a local TCP check found no listener on the default OpenD port 127.0.0.1:11111. Stock Screening V2 membership does not establish complete per-ticker no-match coverage. Engineer identified a separate private artifact boundary that can reuse write_private_draft without changing the normal runner, public validator/viewer, report skill or dirty projection. No authentication or market-data request was made.

checks.description: A deterministic local fixture set demonstrates each discrete KDJ, MACD and Bollinger rule plus missing/stale/conflicting cases.
A rendered viewer check confirms accessible per-ticker counts and details, with counts separate from forecast outputs and invalid data rejected.
evidence: Engineer recommends a private-only computation phase first; public viewer, artifacts and report skill remain outside scope until separately accepted and eligible rights evidence exists.

checks.description: Lead reviews implementation diff and all listed checks before acceptance.

acceptance.description: Accept one provenance-backed source contract and exact, versioned rules for at most one current directional event per indicator, ticker and timeframe; never mix native patterns with local events.
Demonstrate deterministic bullish/bearish and rejection/missing cases for all three indicators using frozen local bars.
Display per-ticker per-indicator counts with accessible details and explicit coverage, independently from forecast direction/targets/confidence.
Record coverage and usability evidence; keep any predictive use out of scope until separately evaluated.
Lead independently reviews complete scoped diff and test evidence.
